QUOTE: The test side is `test_with_valgrind_constant_time` (`tests/scripts/components-configuration-crypto.sh:25`), which runs `tests/suites/*constant_time*.data` under Valgrind and excludes the HMAC data file.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer names a Valgrind test component, but it never says the facility is off-by-default or explicitly not part of the library API. It also says no MBEDTLS_CONSTANT_FLOW symbol exists, which is the opposite of the item's point.
